BackstoryDef.title: Vat-grown soldier
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was grown in a birthing pod, reaching maturity in a matter of days. Implanted with genetic loyalty to the Founders and a dependency on Ketracel White, [PAWN_pronoun] knows only combat and obedience.

BackstoryDef.title: Dominion Trooper
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] has served the Founders in numerous campaigns across the Gamma Quadrant. Victory is life.

BackstoryDef.title: Jem'Hadar First
BackstoryDef.description: Having survived longer than most, [PAWN_nameDef] was promoted to 'First'. [PAWN_pronoun] leads [PAWN_possessive] unit with brutal efficiency.

BackstoryDef.title: Vorta Clone
BackstoryDef.description: Decanted from a cloning facility, [PAWN_nameDef] carries the memories and instincts of [PAWN_possessive] predecessors. Genetically engineered to serve the Founders as administrators.

BackstoryDef.title: Field Supervisor
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was assigned to oversee a Jem'Hadar unit, ensuring their loyalty and dispensing Ketracel White.

BackstoryDef.title: Great Link Origin
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] emerged from the Great Link to explore the galaxy and bring order to the chaos of the solids.

BackstoryDef.title: Living God
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is worshipped as a god by the Jem'Hadar and Vorta. [PAWN_pronoun] demands absolute obedience.
